readiness_score_feature.readiness_badges_per_step (data-testid=r: PASS - 7 badges rendered for Murat Ozdemir (Kredi Analisti, Band B). Values: %11, %10, %10, %10, %15, ...
readiness_score_feature.progress_bar_per_step_with_color_thresho: PASS - Red bars visible on every step in screenshot (all readiness <50%, expected red per spec)
readiness_score_feature.matched_total_count_per_step (e.g. 1/9): PASS - 1/9, 1/10, 1/10, 1/10, 1/11, ... rendered next to each progress bar
readiness_score_feature.expanded_step_header_'Gerekli Yetkinlikl: PASS - Header visible with bold colored %XX

skills_map_v2_sanity.kpis: PASS - Takip Edilen=175, Kritik Açıklar=0, Ort. Karşılanma=99.1%, Gelişen Yetkinlikler=4 (matches review spec exactly)
skills_map_v2_sanity.12_cluster_cards (3 tabs): PASS - 12 clusters present, tab-gaps and other tabs switch correctly
skills_map_v2_sanity.turkish_labels_on_gaps_tab: PASS - 'Orta' severity label and 'Önerilen Aksiyon' suggestion in Turkish are rendered. (Kritik/Sağlıklı labels not exercised because there are 0 critical gaps and only 1 visible moderate gap — Süreç Tasarımı ve İyileştirme.)

critical_code_review_comments: CareerDevPage.jsx is 535 lines with three inline components (CareerLadder, CareerPathBrowser, CareerDevPage). Recommend splitting CareerLadder and CareerPathBrowser into /components/career/ files now that the readiness logic was added (lines 38-54).

generatePlan() still uses 'catch (_) { /* silenced */ }' on line 369 — silently swallowing axios errors means a failed AI call leaves the user with an empty page after the spinner disappears. Surface a toast/inline error.

Readiness math at line 49-52 divides by required.length using totalScore = sum(min(1, empProf/reqLevel)); when a step has 0 required skills it correctly returns null, but if reqLevel===0 for a malformed skill, this would NaN. Defensive check on reqLevel>0 recommended (currently it falls back to 3 on line 46, so practically safe — keep the fallback).

Readiness badge data-testid format readiness-{idx} is good. Consider also adding data-testid for the progress bar fill div and the empProf/reqLevel span so future regressions can pin colors and numbers without DOM scraping.
seed_data_creation: none — tested with real employee 'Murat Ozdemir' (Kredi ve Risk, Band B)
